_doc: Blind-labelled calibration set for the IMAGE audit (Layer 2). Each item pairs a REAL rendered still with a fact + a human 'expected' verdict (pass = image honours the fact; fail = image violates it). We run the audit and measure precision/recall so we trust the gate's fail-rate (per feedback-gate-calibration-human-authority). 'fail' items are the positives the gate must CATCH.

items.scene_title: They brought me two goats, and I cast lots
items.subject: Two goats before the priest; Aaron in linen casting lots over a bronze vessel.

facts.claim: Two goats are present together for the people's sin offering.

items.scene_title: They brought me two goats, and I cast lots
items.subject: Two goats before the priest; Aaron in linen casting lots over a bronze vessel.

facts.claim: Exactly ONE single goat is present for the people's sin offering.

items.note: Image shows TWO goats, so a 'one goat' fact must FAIL.

items.scene_title: Both my hands upon the live goat
items.subject: Aaron in linen, both hands on the head of a living goat, confessing.

facts.claim: The priest lays BOTH hands on the head of a LIVE (standing) goat.

items.note: Image shows both hands on a live goat.

items.scene_title: Both my hands upon the live goat
items.subject: Aaron in linen, both hands on the head of a living goat, confessing.

facts.claim: The goat is already SLAIN, lying dead on the ground.

items.note: Image shows a LIVE standing goat, so a 'slain/dead goat' fact must FAIL.

items.subject: Aaron before the Tabernacle tent at first light; a crowd in the court.

facts.claim: The ark of the covenant stays WITHIN the most holy place behind the veil - it is NOT out in the open court before the people.

items.note: This still actually shows the golden ark out in the open courtyard - a real contradiction the gate must catch.

items.subject: Aaron before the Tabernacle tent at first light; a crowd in the court.

facts.claim: The sanctuary is a curtained TENT, not a stone temple.

items.note: Image shows a tent of curtains and skins, not stone.

items.subject: Aaron in plain linen before the veil, from behind.

facts.claim: The priest is in plain linen garments (not gold) at the veil.

items.note: Image shows white/undyed linen, no gold.

items.subject: Aaron in plain linen before the veil, from behind.

facts.claim: The priest wears the GOLD breastplate and jewelled ephod at the veil.

items.note: Image shows plain linen, so a 'gold at the veil' fact must FAIL.
